scope: Captured from an isolated owned C-Gate 3.4 daemon and random-loopback PCISimulator. No house, Docker, or live C-Bus network was used. Payloads exclude checksum and confirmation code.
help: Help: AUDIO commands:
Help:  AUDIO ? Help for these commands
Help:  AUDIO CURRENT_FEED - Send a Current Feed command
Help:  AUDIO DYNAMIC_1 - Send a Dynamic 1 command
Help:  AUDIO DYNAMIC_2 - Send a Dynamic 2 command
Help:  AUDIO HIGH_PRIORITY - Send a High Priority command

validated_boundaries.application: Audio application 205 (0xCD); decimal, $CD, lowercase z, own fully-qualified path, and $ numeric arguments accepted
validated_boundaries.mute: 0..7 and 255 are clean successes; 8..254 transmit with a 400 continuation followed by 200 OK
validated_boundaries.output_sentinel: omitted or -1 OUTPUT_COMMON_CONTROL and OUTPUT_DEVICE_STATUS_REQUEST values transmit FF and return 200

negative_examples.response: 400 Syntax Error: Integer parameter is out of range : <multiplexer>
400 Syntax Error: Integer parameter is out of range : <gain>
400 Syntax Error: Integer parameter is out of range : <option>
401 Bad object or device ID: ? (Network not found)

command_events.event: current_feed multiplexer=2 zone=7 feed=7 gain=4 sourceUnit=4
ramp multiplexer=1 zone=2 functioncode=7 level=255 ramprate=15 sourceUnit=4
set_feed multiplexer=1 zone=2 feed=7 option=1 sourceUnit=4

inbound_decoder.z_transform: dynamic/feed/language force low bits 6, mute forces 5, request operations clear the low three bits
inbound_decoder.ramp_overlap: RAMP decodes only for group 0..191; 192..194 decode HIGH_PRIORITY, 232 CURRENT_FEED, 233 SET_FEED, and other Z values emit no Audio event

label_load_icon_evidence_gap.manual: label and load_icon are advertised as event-only Audio operations
label_load_icon_evidence_gap.native_result: valid A0..BF label and icon frames produced no event; C0 Unicode was logged as unknown SAL
label_load_icon_evidence_gap.cause: retained decoder compares a byte-length field with hexadecimal character length, so the standard label branch cannot succeed
label_load_icon_evidence_gap.cmqttd_behavior: cbus-protocol decodes the intended retained A0 layout and cmqttd can fan it out as an explicit repair; this exceeds observed C-Gate 3.4.0.2001 behavior and is not claimed as byte-for-byte native event parity

delivery_semantics.native: C-Gate returned 200 before PCI confirmation; deliberate NAK and NET CLOSE probes still returned 200
delivery_semantics.cmqttd: returns success only after correlated confirmation on the active PCI generation; NAK, timeout, closure, or reconnect fail closed

routing_boundary: No routed Audio write was evidenced. cmqttd accepts only its bound direct application and fails closed for other paths.
